**Credit:** Score 705, no bankruptcy/foreclosure — meets DU requirements.  
**DTI:** 36.98% (housing $2,842 + auto $560 ÷ income $9,200) — within DU limits.  
**LTV:** 90% — triggers minimum borrower contribution rule for second home.  
**Funds to close:** $52,821 (down payment $41,000 + closing costs $11,821).  
**Available funds:** $8,500 (bank) + $53,705 (gift from parent, acceptable donor, gift letter present) = $62,205.  
**Reserves:** 3.3 months after closing — exceeds 2-month requirement for second home (B3-4.1-01).  
**Minimum borrower contribution:** For second home with LTV > 80%, borrower must contribute 5% of property value ($20,500) from own funds (B3-4.3-04). Borrower has only $8,500 own funds — short $12,000. Gift cannot fill this gap. A condition cannot require additional funds.

DECISION: decline  
RULES: B3-4.3-04
